svg.title: RmsNormKernel on one row
svg.text: RmsNormKernel on one row: 256 threads × Items = 8 values, width 1,536
x = the embedding of " is", weight = layer 0 input_layernorm. LaunchRmsNorm picks Items = 8: 1,536 > 4 × 256.
Thread 3 (the amber column) through both passes:
Amber: stored. Store rounds each y to the output type (FP32, BF16 or FP16).
thread t loads elements t, t + 256, …; past the end it holds 0
each thread sums its squares, BlockSum adds the 256 sums, every thread computes inverse_rms
the second pass reuses values[] from registers: scale, multiply by weight, store
LaunchRmsNorm picks Items = 4, 8 or 16 from the width
